verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Navan has its own cards: the API handles 'Navan card transactions', and card management covers which cards are active or inactive and how many cards a user has. Nothing documents how cards are issued, whether physical or virtual cards are offered, how fast issuance is, or setting a spend limit per card. Missing for 10: documented physical and virtual card issuance, quick self-serve issuance to team members, per-card spend limit controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
